title: ImageGem In-the-wild Generative Interaction Dataset for Generative Model Personalization
one_line: ImageGem数据集与LoRA个性化框架，风格转换任务验证有限

experiment_framework: DiffusionDB评估偏好对齐，Recall@k和NDCG@k评估检索性能，CLIP和PickScore评估生成质量
